general_information.test_case_name: Poisson on cuboid weak scaling test
general_information.test_case_description: Weak scaling of the Poisson model with a manufactured solution on a 3D cuboid. The grid grows in x with the MPI rank count.
general_information.simulation_description:
Weak scaling test for Poisson equation on a 3D cuboid.
The manufactured solution is a simple product of sines and cosines.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set in direction x.
